text:
olivia: heads-up — staging cutover tomorrow 03:00 UTC. there's a console header-split + router change in this wave that could trigger eviction on a small shard. thinking we should pin runtime for the window and hold the deploy until telemetry looks good.
max: +1 to pin. can we pin runtime v2.14.1 for the staging wave and put a deploy-bot hold until we validate? also propose a 30m advance warm-up.
maya: quick smoke just now against staging: noticed ~5% 503s when header payload >4k. small sample but consistent across two runs. logs show router hitting header-parsing backoff.
maya: ```
[staging-router] 2024-11-04T22:12:09Z WARN header_parse_timeout id=shard-7
[staging-runtime] 2024-11-04T22:12:10Z INFO eviction_triggered keys=42 reason=large-headers
```
sree: can we add a short-lived telemetry panel and alert for eviction_rate and router.request.size_histogram? want to watch both error surface and header-size distribution during the rollout.
tara: i'll bump console trace retention to 72h for this wave and add a dedicated panel. tagging @infra for any infra-side retention changes.
max: deploy-bot command to hold is below — i'll run it once we agree.
max: ```
/deploy hold staging --reason "console-header-split" --by max --until 1763143500
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled release at 2024-11-05T03:00Z for staging. to place a hold run `/deploy hold staging`.
olivia: rollback criteria suggestion: >1% user-facing errors for more than 5m OR sustained p50 latency >350ms for 10m. anything else to add?
maya: add increased error spike on churned sessions (session-reset metric) — if session resets double, roll back.
sree: alert query i've added to grafana: `sum(rate(eviction_triggered[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m]))` -> panel linked. will also add `eviction_rate > 0.01 for 5m` as a firing rule.
max: ok i'm going to pin runtime -> v2.14.1 and place the hold now. will post the deploy-bot event id.
max: (running) `/deploy hold staging --reason "console-header-split"`
deploy-bot: hold placed by max at 1763141700 (reason: console-header-split)
maya: running another smoke at +5m, will post results.
sree: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/evict/width-watch — check `router.request.size_histogram` and `eviction_rate` panels.
tara: dashboard updated and retention bumped. added a small note in the release doc under "observability".
max: release notes draft: "Pinned runtime v2.14.1 for staging window; deploy hold engaged for header-split risk; added router size guardrails and eviction alerting. Lift hold when canary shows stable for 15m and eviction_rate <0.005."
olivia: :eyes: thanks everyone. i'll coordinate lift/clear signals from here and call an immediate rollback if criteria hit. please keep posts concise in this thread so oncall can follow.
maya: smoke results: 1st run 503s dropped to 0.6%, 2nd run 0.4%. screenshots uploaded.
max: :thumbsup: looks good. i'll schedule the warm-up 30m prior and then we can gradually nudge traffic.
deploy-bot: note: remember to run `/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-7` if you want cache warming.
sree: i'll keep the grafana alert active for 2h post-cutover. if it fires i'll ping here.
tara: tagging @infra again for any late network tweaks.
olivia: final — pin + hold + warm-up scheduled. lift plan: must see 15m stable canary with eviction_rate <0.005 and p50 <300ms. if any criteria breached -> rollback.
max: i'll post the deploy-bot release id when we unhold. thanks all.
